limits: No console contact: FTP is never invoked by the fixtures; live mode is controller-only after the user confirms 'in game'.

Baselines are controller-captured launch10-prep bytes; this worker verified their sha256 on THIS host but did not re-fetch them from the console - the runbook's pre-launch re-fetch + re-pin remains the law, and --baseline-dir must point at the freshly fetched files on launch day.

The stage table classifies r13/r14 marker vocabulary read from source; the actual launch-10 fself may be r14+armed-table+GMalloc-validator - if the rebuild adds NEW tags (e.g. beyond worker-diagnostic-sink's set) they will surface as raw lines/OTHER, never silently dropped, and STAGE-TABLE.md will need a bounded revision with new ids.
The '[Seeds]' armed-path success wording remains not verbatim-pinned anywhere readable; unmatched [Seeds] lines are reported verbatim as seeds-other (honesty limit inherited from launch-9).

Timing semantics: PATH_TEST stamps and failure-line prefixes are single points per launch, not durations; the only true per-stage elapsed table comes from the supplier-diag jsonl IF the diagnostic-sink landed. The tool never fabricates durations and never subtracts across writers.

Config-drift detection is negative-evidence-based (growth where growth is forbidden): a stale ini with disabled plugins could still write nothing, which looks identical to compliance; the ini pre-image gate in the runbook is the positive check.

Classification is evidence interpretation, not acceptance: MODS_STARTED carries explicit beyond-prediction skepticism; rung advancement stays governed by FIRST-RUN-PLAYBOOK section 5 and the ge.5 gate.
